targets.title: Mark Minervini’s Trading Psychology Secrets | 6 Rules Every Trader Should Know
targets.author: Financial Wisdom
targets.text:
Why do so many traders struggle even when they already know a good strategy?

In this video, I break down six powerful trading psychology lessons from Mark Minervini and explain why discipline, objectivity and execution can matter just as much as the strategy itself.

One of Minervini’s most important ideas is that traders should focus only on what they can control: what they buy, how much they buy, when they buy and when they sell.
